'''Shift Sense''' was a [[Force power/Legends#Sense|Sense]]-based [[The Force/Legends|Force]] power. It allowed the individual to shift their senses to detect phenomena that were usually beyond their normal range, such as shifting their vision to detect [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] or [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|radio]] waves, detecting certain chemical combinations through their olfactory senses, or perceiving higher or lower sound frequencies. The ability shares similarities with [[Magnify Senses]].<ref name=":0">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>

Aleema Keto was known to use this power.<ref name=":0" />
